steps.prompt: Say this in five words or fewer: “At this point in time, due to the fact that it is raining, we are unable to go outside.”

cards.title: Every word does a job
cards.body: Concise writing uses the fewest words that keep the meaning. Wordy phrases slow the reader down: in order to → to, due to the fact that → because, has the ability to → can, at this point in time → now.

cards.title: Start with your point
cards.body: Cut throat-clearing phrases: “It is important to note that…”, “The reason why is because…”, “Needless to say…”. Begin with what matters.

cards.title: Before and after
cards.text:
Before: Due to the fact that landfills are filling up, each and every town has the ability to make a difference.
After: Because landfills are filling up, every town can make a difference.

prompts: Which wordy phrase do you use most?
How did cutting words change how the paragraph sounds?
